basis: Independent interpretation of the exact captured F1 endpoint-grade receipt and terminal-result review hashes; no grader rerun and no prediction-array access.

interpretation.comparison_scope: One paired fold/seed cell toward the declared 30 paired cells per arm. The grade itself labels fold 1 as previously exposed screening evidence, not held-out confirmation.
interpretation.decision: Retain as one screening pair; do not declare a width winner, rank promotion, convergence, or held-out confirmation from this result.
interpretation.f0_direction_context: The separately reviewed F0 single-pair delta was positive and this F1 single-pair delta is negative. This direction reversal is descriptive only; no F0/F1 pooling, averaging, or combined estimate is made, and it does not establish a robust width advantage.
interpretation.finding: The F1 wide candidate is lower than deep by 0.0003656005145715735 on this pair. The paired component-bootstrap 95% interval crosses zero, so this single screened pair does not establish a robust wide advantage.

limitations: This interval resamples 149 whole evaluation components containing 457 sequences on one previously exposed fold and one fitting seed; it is not uncertainty across folds, seeds, or external transfer.

No raw prediction payloads, checkpoint tensors, model execution, grader rerun, or parquet data were accessed; terminal structural reviews do not independently validate the grade receipt or its prediction payloads.
The F0 value is included only as hash-bound directional context; F0 and F1 are not pooled or treated as a joint estimate.
The result is one of 30 required paired cells per arm; it does not complete the declared comparison.

bootstrap.method: paired whole-component bootstrap using centered moments

pair.classification: previously exposed fold; screening evidence, not held-out confirmation
